mapper.select: select user_id from t_user where user_id = #{expertUserId} and coalesce(status, 0) = 0 for update

select assignment.id from t_copywriting_expert_assignment assignment inner join t_copywriting copywriting on copywriting.user_id = assignment.account_user_id where copywriting.copywriting_id = #{copywritingId} and assignment.expert_user_id = #{expertUserId} limit 1 for update
